Returns the current target groups.
Content type
Caution: Target groups were deprecated in Tenable Vulnerability Management on February 4th, 2022.
Tenable recommends that customers use tags instead to group and scan assets. Please update any
existing integrations that your organization has. If you want to automatically migrate your target
groups to tags via the API and pyTenable, see Migrate Target Groups to Tags. For more information
about tags, see Tags in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
